justifications.fit: the new field is a plain optional str on ModelConfig beside hf_repo (imas_ambix/agent/profile.py:33-35), the generator's list-of-lines with conditional appends matches the router generator already in the file at imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:1148-1176 including its return at :1293, and the whole-tree ruff check over imas_ambix and tests printed All checks passed! with no naming finding against _REVISION_TOKEN at imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:42.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_ambix/agent/profiles/deepseek-v4-1-flash.toml:59,65,71 name the 1017 repository, commit and directory and imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:1221 passes --revision, but the generated serve script carries only the weights directory and no revision, which plan section 2's done-when at docs/plans/rotate-to-deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017.html:79 asks the serve --dry-run to name.
justifications.reuse: a search of the repository for a revision- or commit-pinning mechanism (grep for --revision, models info and a revision field across imas_ambix and tests) found the only occurrences inside this diff, so ModelConfig.revision at imas_ambix/agent/profile.py:35 is the first owner of that capability and extends the existing ModelConfig and generate_download_script rather than forking them, and the test helpers _site_for, _write_hf_stub and _run_download_script (tests/test_agent_dspark_profile.py:194-218) stub the site's own hf_path binary, which no prior test helper does.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff a7d24c5a..6c02d728 changes exactly the six paths plan section 2 declares, with nothing outside them, though imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:1208-1293 rewrites 127 lines where a conditional block could have been interpolated into the existing f-string, and that latitude is bounded by download-script-delta.log, which shows all nine unpinned profiles generating byte-identical scripts.
